source_hypotheses.required: 1999 0.1 requires every multiple of N_K coprime to Nprime; 0.7 uses its normed Iwasawa class.
source_hypotheses.constructed: N_K=2Nd, Nprime=c*d_s, with gcd=1 by K5 and d|F.
source_hypotheses.justification: Original definitions were read. Existing rational-away-2 representation hypotheses are retained, not inferred from residual irreducibility.

constructed_objects.required: An integral compatible T*chi-valued Euler system in the stated cohomology groups.
constructed_objects.constructed: K8 defined for all positive m prime to c*d_s, using the same original z_(Dm), symbol and smoothers.
constructed_objects.justification: 2004 8.1.3 and 8.9-8.12 allow these levels. K7 supplies j-star descent; the fixed lattice map is used uniformly.

index_domain_coverage.required: All m divisible by N_K and coprime to Nprime, including conductor and bad primes.
index_domain_coverage.constructed: The expanded K8 domain includes every such m and retains the old Xi subfamily.
index_domain_coverage.justification: S_(Dm) misses smoothing primes. The former Xi restriction is no longer incorrectly used to satisfy the larger 1999 domain.

transition_maps.required: 1999 0.1.1: identity for repeated primes, P_l(l^-1 sigma_l^-1) for new primes.
transition_maps.constructed: If l|m the supports agree; otherwise N_K|m implies l does not divide 2Nd and exactly l is added.
transition_maps.justification: Prop8.12 and tensor/corestriction equivariance give both cases, with no bad-prime Euler polynomial substituted.

limiting_object_identity.required: The 0.7 class for divisor parameter1 must be the supplied retained dyadic class.
limiting_object_identity.constructed: Displayed corestriction identity from N_K*2^n to 2^n for every n>=1.
limiting_object_identity.justification: Equal construction supports give exact norm of original classes. Transitivity through two intermediate fields in one upper field gives y_(2^n); no field-degree scalar. The fixed lattice factor is separately stated.

coefficient_conventions.required: Arithmetic Frobenius on T*chi, inverse deck element in Euler substitution; integral lattice followed by localization away2.
coefficient_conventions.constructed: P_l(X)=1-a_l chi(l)X+lX^2. Optional uniform2^c_E sends original lattice into T.
coefficient_conventions.justification: chi is quadratic, so the equivariance scalar matches K9. The fixed factor is a unit only at the explicitly used away-2 primes, preserving J there.

local_conditions.required: 1999 full cohomology uses fixed inverted N_K; 2004 construction is j-star over the dyadic open scheme.
local_conditions.constructed: The proof distinguishes the varying construction support S_(Dm) from primes inverted in the 1999 scheme.
local_conditions.justification: K7 gives the integral j-star property even for ramified transfer; restriction then supplies full cohomology. Existing local-complex comparison is unchanged.

exceptional_cases.required: Repeated bad/conductor primes, dyadic conductor, smoothing primes, initial dyadic levels and the reused symbol d.
exceptional_cases.constructed: Repeated support gives factor1; smoothers are excluded; n>=1 is cofinal; source divisor parameter1 is distinguished from conductor d.
exceptional_cases.justification: No disjointness of the two intermediate cyclotomic fields is assumed. Full D remains in every upper field. No assertion that 3 always belongs to Sigma is needed.

downstream_consumption.required: K15 must bound J of the actual supplied retained class, not an arbitrary proportional generator.
downstream_consumption.constructed: xi_K is the full-cohomology image of y_(2^infinity), with only the stated uniform lattice map.
downstream_consumption.justification: The equality and away-2 unit show its localized coordinate ideal is J. The subsequent unchanged cohomology comparison transfers the bound in the convention consumed by K15.
